name: Anvil Ward
description: Anvil Ward. Arm it on a forge attempt at +8 or above and a FAILURE holds the plus instead of dropping one. Costs as many wards as the plus it starts from, so a push to +9 costs 8 — and they are spent whether the attempt lands or not. They go straight onto your forge counter, not into your bag, so a letter of them can be collected with a full backpack.

name: Companion Ticket
description: Companion Ticket. Starts a co-op attempt on the strip, where friends fight your stage alongside you, and pays for a World Boss run once the day's free run is spent — only the host spends one, guests join free, and a failed attempt costs another to run again. Earned in the Tower: every floor you clear for the FIRST time pays one, and every repeat clear has a 5% chance. They go straight onto your counter, not into your bag, so a letter of them can be collected with a full backpack.

name: Plain Enchantment Stone
description: Plain Enchantment Stone. Pays for one forge attempt on Plain-band gear (item level 1–70) — one stone per attempt, landed or not. They go straight onto your forge counter, not into your bag, so a letter of them can be collected with a full backpack.

name: Forged Enchantment Stone
description: Forged Enchantment Stone. Pays for one forge attempt on Forged-band gear (item level 80–150) — one stone per attempt, landed or not. They go straight onto your forge counter, not into your bag, so a letter of them can be collected with a full backpack.

name: Mastercraft Enchantment Stone
description: Mastercraft Enchantment Stone. Pays for one forge attempt on Mastercraft-band gear (item level 160–230) — one stone per attempt, landed or not. They go straight onto your forge counter, not into your bag, so a letter of them can be collected with a full backpack.

name: Mythic Enchantment Stone
